review:
Eye of Spartacus is a 5x5 gladiator slot built around an expanding wild. Whenever the Roman warrior lands, in the base game or the bonus, he can expand vertically to fill his reel and carries a random multiplier from 2x to 100x. When more than one of these wilds is part of the same winning combination, their multipliers are added together.

Three golden lion scatters award 10 free spins. During the bonus, each expanding wild adds one more free spin and upgrades every instance of the lowest high-paying symbol on screen into the next symbol up, gradually improving the symbol mix as the round continues. Pragmatic Play advertises wins up to 10,000x. The RTP is 96.42%. The symbol upgrade gives the bonus a nice sense of progression.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Provider doesn't publish a volatility rating
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
